verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, including the GST portal, so the axis applies. No evidence item shows a robots.txt at gst.gov.in or developer.gst.gov.in. The only probe concerns the separate income-tax portal's front-door HTML, not robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
